summary:
ASTROHEALTH is a PHP 8 and MySQL web application designed for astronaut health monitoring, clinical review, mission operations, wellness, and offline record synchronisation. It provides a centralised platform where astronauts can submit and view their health observations, assessments, and wellness activities. Flight surgeons review clinical information only for astronauts assigned to them, while administrators manage accounts and missions without unrestricted access to clinical records.

The system records health indicators with values, units, sources, devices, timestamps, and sync status. Flight surgeons can establish individual reference baselines. The application sends warning notifications when numeric readings fall outside a valid, clinician-reviewed range. These alerts are warnings, not diagnoses. Offline synchronisation uploads records when connectivity returns, while duplicate protection and conflict handling help prevent existing observations from being overwritten.

ASTROHEALTH features a responsive space-themed interface with an animated astronaut, Earth and orbital effects, moving colour highlights, smooth transitions, and a scrolling illustrative ECG display. The ECG is visual, not a live medical signal.

Built using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XAMPP, the project aims to improve organisation and continuity of astronaut health information.
details:
ASTROHEALTH – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTROHEALTH is a web-based astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support the health and wellbeing of astronauts during space missions. It provides a centralised system where astronauts can record health observations, monitor vital indicators, access wellness activities, and receive notifications when readings fall outside their clinician-approved personal health ranges.

The system supports three main user roles: astronauts, flight surgeons, and administrators. Astronauts can submit and view their own health records, flight surgeons can review the health information of astronauts assigned to them, and administrators can manage user accounts and missions.

ASTROHEALTH includes health observation tracking, medical assessments, clinical reviews, mission management, wellness activities, notifications, and offline data synchronisation. Its offline synchronisation feature helps preserve records when connectivity is unavailable and allows them to be uploaded when connectivity returns.

The project was developed using PHP 8, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with XAMPP used as the local development environment.

What makes ASTROHEALTH creative is its space-inspired interface, featuring an animated astronaut, a rotating Earth and orbital effects, a moving ECG-style display, and smooth page transitions. It combines practical health-record management with an engaging space-themed user experience.

The intended impact is to improve the organisation, accessibility, and continuity of astronaut health information, support clinical oversight, and contribute to safer and more informed space missions. ASTROHEALTH is a prototype that would require further clinical validation and security testing before real-world medical deployment.
